user.title: Connect to Pendel
user.description: Enter the address of your Pendel instance and your login. Home Assistant creates its own API token; the password is not stored.

totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.description: Your Pendel account uses two-factor authentication. Enter the current code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code).

tracking.title: Automatic tracking
tracking.description: Choose the person whose location Pendel should use and the zones for home and office.

data_description.track_location: Pendel uses this to record commutes, office time and breaks automatically.
data_description.office_zone: The zone of your workplace. Create it under Settings → Areas & zones if it does not exist yet.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Pendel ({url}) rejected the token. Sign in again to create a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Pendel at this address.
error.invalid_auth: Wrong email or password (or too many attempts).
error.same_zone: Home and office must be different zones.
error.invalid_totp: The code is invalid or has already been used.

abort.already_configured: This Pendel account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: This is a different Pendel account.
